data.question: Do I need to be a Computer Science or IT major to join?
data.answer: No. GDGoC UGM is open to all students from any faculty or department. Different majors and different starting points — that's the point.

data.question: Is this only for first-year students?
data.answer: No, it's open to anyone currently enrolled at Universitas Gadjah Mada. Whether you're a first-year student, a senior, or even a postgraduate — you're welcome to join.

data.question: How do I find the right track for me?
data.answer: Start by exploring the overview page. Each track has a description of what you'll do and what skills you'll grow. Pick the one that makes you curious — you don't need to have experience first.

data.question: How much time commitment is expected per week?
data.answer: It varies by format. Study groups and project circles usually take 2–4 hours per week. Workshops are one-time events. You decide the pace.

data.question: I have no tech experience. Can I still join?
data.answer: Absolutely. You don't need to be a coding prodigy or have technical skills. You just need curiosity. We'll take it from there.

data.question: I have a project idea. How can I collaborate with GDGoC?
data.answer: Use the contact form and select 'Collaboration'. Share the idea, who it's for, and how you imagine working with the community.

data.question: Can I host a workshop or knowledge-sharing session?
data.answer: Yes! If you have something you've learned that others might find useful, reach out via the contact form and select 'Speaking & sharing'.
